name: MJ26 RGB LED Ring Light 26cm with Tripod, Phone Holder & 360° Color Modes
description:
Upgrade your setup with the MJ26 RGB LED Ring Light (26cm), designed for flawless, shadow-free lighting. Featuring 128 premium LEDs, it delivers adjustable white and RGB modes with 360° color rotation. With 10 brightness levels, USB-powered convenience, and a stable tripod with phone holder, it’s perfect for videos, photography, live streams, or creative shoots. Built for creators, makeup artists, and professionals who need versatility and precision.
Key Features
 Adjustable RGB & white light with 360° color rotation
 10 brightness levels (10%–100%) for custom lighting
 26cm soft ring with 128 LEDs for even illumination
 USB powered for portable, plug-and-play use
 Flexible tripod + universal phone holder for stability
 360° rotation ball head for perfect angle control
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic, acrylic, 128 LED lamp beads, electronic components
How to Use
 Connect the ring light to a USB power source
 Adjust color and brightness via the controller
 Mount phone in the holder and set tripod height
 Rotate ball head to achieve the ideal lighting angle
Package Includes
 1 × MJ26 RGB LED Ring Light (26cm)
 1 × Adjustable Tripod (up to 1.8m)
 1 × Phone Holder (5.7–8.0cm grip)
 1 × USB Power Cable
